The node runner covers 253 of 1270 files

label: The corpus is 1270 test files and 1124 of them sit under .skilled, with specs contributing 111, .opencode 35 and .pi 12; .opencode links into .skilled rather than duplicating the suites.
run-node-tests.mjs gates 253 files (250 node:test and 3 vitest) under five roots, leaving 1017 files (80 percent) outside it.
The runner executes the whole node corpus in one node --test process with a ten-minute timeout plus one vitest process, and walks the tree twice for its discovery canary.
The two measurable advisory steps are cheap: doc-model reference validation 2.77 s and trigger-index --check 4.53 s, so the job 87 s mean is the node corpus, not the validators.

The 777 .vitest.ts files reach CI only through spec-kit-check root and cli vitest projects, four named suites in routing-registry-drift, and the hooks tree; a suite outside those include patterns runs nowhere.

spec-kit-check pays for the entire CLI and runtime vitest corpus in one eleven-step job that is also the only door for two thirds of the .vitest.ts files, so narrowing it without relocating those suites drops them silently.
